all_wardrobe.costume_description: Reflective cybernetic jacket, weather-resistant tactical wear
Dark tech-visor, futuristic comm-headset, hacker/operator attire
Heavy tactical combat armor, helmets, visors

shots.description: Wide establishing shot of the neon-lit alleyway, rain pouring on wet asphalt. Neo sprints into frame.
shots.shot_requirements: Rain machine, neon practical lighting, wet-down crew
Steadicam rig, waterproof housing, stunt coordination
shots.description: Tracking shot running behind and beside Neo as he clutches the glowing chrome briefcase. Enforcers pursue in the background with raised plasma batons.
shots.dialogue_snippet: Kira, I've got heat! Unlock the dock door now!

action_beats: Neo sprints through a wet, neon-lit alleyway carrying a glowing briefcase while pursued by armed Enforcers.
Neo contacts Kira via wrist comm for extraction.

dialogue_snippets.line: Kira, I've got heat! Unlock the dock door now!
Door 4 is open, Neo! Watch the drone above you!

shots.dialogue_snippet: Door 4 is open, Neo! Watch the drone above you!
shots.description: Medium shot of Kira at her holographic keyboard, multiple floating video feeds reflecting on her tech-visor.
shots.shot_requirements: Holographic CGI elements added in post-production, interactive screen lighting on actress

action_beats: Kira frantically taps at a holographic keyboard in a dark control room, monitoring multiple video feeds and guiding Neo.

shots.description: Neo slides across the bonnet of a parked hover-car as a surveillance drone descends from above with a harsh spotlight.
shots.shot_requirements: Stunt double for car slide, specialized vehicle prop

shots.description: Close-up on Neo drawing the EMP disruptor from his holster, aiming upward.
shots.shot_requirements: Prop weapon with LED muzzle effect
CGI drone explosion/spark effects, breakaway trash cans, stunt wire rig for drone crash
shots.description: Blue energy wave pulses from disruptor, hitting the drone. Drone sparks, short-circuits, and crashes into alley trash cans. Neo finishes at the door.

action_beats: Neo slides across a hover-car bonnet. A surveillance drone descends, pinning him with a spotlight.
Neo draws an EMP disruptor and disables the drone, which crashes into trash cans.
